grid_lost_window: ⚡ {prefix}Power went out between {earliest} and {time} (the station was offline, exact time unknown)
grid_restored_window: ✅ {prefix}Power came back between {earliest} and {time} (the station was offline, exact time unknown)
bot_started_battery: 🔋 {prefix}Bot started: the station has been on battery since {since}
bot_started_battery_unknown: 🔋 {prefix}Bot started: the station is currently on battery (since {since} at the latest)
ac_off: ⚠️ {prefix}The station's AC output is off. During an outage nothing on the station's AC outlets will be powered. Turn AC output on (and AC ECO off).
station_offline: 📡 {prefix}No connection to the station since {since}. Grid state is unknown. If your router or ISP has no backup power, this often means an outage.
station_online: 📡 {prefix}Connection to the station is back (lost for {duration}).
auth_expired: 🔑 The BLUETTI login has expired. Run `bluetti-grid-bot login` again and update BLUETTI_REFRESH_TOKEN. The bot keeps retrying.
status_unknown_offline: Grid: unknown ❔ — no connection to the station since {since}
status_unknown_baseline: Grid: unknown ❔ — not enough data yet
status_ac_off_warning: ⚠️ The station's AC output is off: its outlets will not be powered during an outage.
status_ac_eco_warning: ⚠️ AC ECO is on: the AC output may switch itself off at low load and will not switch back on. Turning it off is recommended.
status_never_polled: The station has not been polled successfully yet.
status_no_stations: No stations found yet (the bot is starting or the BLUETTI cloud is unreachable).
status_auth_expired: 🔑 The BLUETTI login is invalid — run `login` again.
help:
This bot reports grid power outages using a BLUETTI power station.

/status — current station and grid state, last 7 days
/stats [days] — outage statistics (default 30 days)
/schedule — planned outages for today and tomorrow
/history [n] — last n outages (default 10)
/help — this help
hint_longer_than_usual: This outage is already longer than usual.
hint_enough: The battery should last until power is back as usual (≈ {remaining} more) ✅
hint_short: ⚠️ The battery may run out before power is back as usual (≈ {remaining} more).
stats_by_hour: By hour (share of days without power):
schedule_none: 📅 No more planned outages in the published schedule (group {group})
schedule_unknown: 📅 The schedule for today is not published (group {group})
schedule_unavailable: The outage schedule is not available yet (SCHEDULE_PROVIDER is off, or the source is unreachable).
schedule_not_published: The schedule for today is not published yet.
schedule_published: 📅 A new outage schedule is out.
schedule_warning_low: The battery is not charged much — keep that in mind.
